title: Migrate duplicate native-profile derivations in app_identity.c + gcp_trust.c (cross-impl coordinated)
description: Discovered from i72x.1 (worker7). Two C TUs inline their OWN copy of the rejected SHA-512 native-profile routable-address derivation instead of calling lichen_identity_ygg_addr_from_ed25519: lichen/subsys/lichen/app_identity/app_identity.c:46-63 (derive_addresses: ygg_addr=[0x02]||SHA-512[0:7]||SHA-512[0:8] U/L-cleared) and lichen/subsys/lichen/gcp/gcp_trust.c:51-66 (gcp_trust_derive_ygg_addr, same construction). They were NOT in the i72x epic's audit list and NOT in i72x.1's scope. They MUST NOT be migrated piecemeal: gcp_trust feeds cross-implementation gateway protocols whose Python/Rust sides still derive the native profile (Python identity.py:206-234), so a C-only swap breaks C<->Python agreement TODAY. Migrate together with the Python/Rust derivations (i72x.2 + a Python child that does not exist yet), or first convert both to call lichen_identity_ygg_addr_from_ed25519 so there is exactly one C derivation site, then migrate once. Consumers to fix: app_identity tests (Zephyr test lichen/tests/app_identity, byte-pinned addresses), gcp3_trust_models.json (already quarantine-noted by q6ko.6), any coap_keys/app-identity CLI surface.
close_reason: Both C duplicate derivations now delegate to lichen_identity_ygg_addr_from_ed25519 (single C derivation site, upstream AddrForKey since i72x.1). Ground-truth corrections to the bead's own premise (mine): (1) gcp_trust_derive_ygg_addr has ZERO callers and ZERO C tests, and CONFIG_LICHEN_GCP_TRUST=y is enabled nowhere — no piecemeal breakage exists; the C<->Python wire divergence already holds post-i72x.1 by epic design (tracked: i72x.2 Rust, i72x.6 Python+corpora). (2) app_identity derive_addresses is C-local with a C-local Zephyr test. app_identity.c keeps the SHA-512 IID inline (retained derivation), swaps only the routable half; gcp_trust.c gains #include <lichen/link_ctx.h>. Test vector: upstream AddrForKey(schnorr48_derive_keypair(0x00..0x1f)=03a107bf...5531b8) = 02062f7c200618f7a0f14791738c5a1f, oracle upstream address_test.go anchor cross-checked with an independent port (never the C impl). Verified: app_identity native_sim 6/6+13/13 PASS, ping_l2 native_sim 8/8 PASS (re-run — it exercises app-identity publish vs link ctx), tunnel_auth host PASS (no ygg-byte assertions; Python's shared-JSON assertion stays native per i72x.6), gcp_trust.c gcc -fsyntax-only clean, sweep confirms no inline native-profile copies remain in C. 3x codereview (correctness/security/edge) all PASS inline — reviewer delegation still returning empty output (3rd round; flagged for Mark). Comment added to i72x.6 noting tunnel_authorization.json needs the same regeneration when Python migrates. Commit 0185d003d4.
